title: Diablo II: Resurrected
provenance: Reported by JabesRUS (highball#371, 2026-10-17) for the Battle.net copy, Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15: on the default engine (x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26 and r27) with D3DMetal the game process sits idle after start and never opens a window; on the Wine 11 engine r23 Battle.net itself crashed (int3 in its embedded browser). Background, not measured here: Blizzard's January 2026 update tripped a Rosetta 2 deadlock that also hit Diablo IV and Overwatch 2 (Apple Developer Forums thread 814383, FB15880492 and FB21763885), and CodeWeavers reports Diablo IV and Overwatch running again on CrossOver 26.1 with macOS 26.5. Not verified by the maintainer. Swiss-Mac-User (highball#371, 2026-10-18), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.19: on the Wine 11 engine with D3DMetal and DXMT_ALLOW_CROSS_PROCESS_SWAPCHAIN=1, Battle.net crashed after login with repeated crash dialogs, so D2R could not be started there. AlexPako (highball#371, 2026-11-12), Apple M5 Pro 24 GB, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.26, the Steam copy (Infernal Edition, 2536520): on the default engine r28 with D3DMetal D2R.exe sits at about 0% CPU with no window, AVX advertised or not; on the Wine 11 engines r31 (D3DMetal 3) and r30 (D3DMetal 4 beta 3) it exits before a window with every sync and DLSS setting tried, and two direct runs outside the app ended on SIGILL. The same player (highball-db#1194, 2026-11-13), macOS 27.2.1, rated 3 of 5, playable with workarounds: it played on an engine they put together by hand, the Wine of the Wine 11 engine r4 (engine-wine-11.0-20260905T100545Z-cef60263) with r31's graphics and runtime parts and r31's nvapi stub, Windows 10, D3DMetal, AVX advertised, sync none, DLSS and frame generation off, plus HB_AUDIOBUF=0, CX_ACTIVE_GRAPHICS_BACKEND=d3dmetal, CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH set to r31's libd3dshared.dylib and WINEDLLPATH_PREPEND set to r31's D3DMetal and DXMT folders (none shown to be needed one by one); with r9's Wine it hung instead. About 116 fps at 1920x1080 and 58.9 fps at 4K with 80% render scale and a 60 fps cap, in short tests. The cursor switched between the game's and the Mac's while the Metal performance HUD was on, and stopped with the HUD off. AlexPako again (highball#371, 2026-11-16), M5 Pro, macOS 27.2.1, Highball 0.10.26: on r31 with the Wine of the build that became r34 and r35 (highball-engine run 43624249972), HB_FIBER_MIRROR=0 alone left the game running with no window, HB_FIBER_MIRROR=0 with CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH set to r31's libd3dshared.dylib played for 35 minutes with sync off and again with MSync, switching away and back worked, and without HB_FIBER_MIRROR the game exited after about four seconds.
notes: Direct3D 12, so D3DMetal. The Steam copy plays on the Wine 11 engine r35 with the game's recipe, which comes with the next Highball release after 0.10.28: it turns off Wine's fiber copy for this game and has Wine load D3DMetal's libd3dshared.dylib (highball#371). Every Wine 11 engine before r35 stops it a few seconds after start, and the default Wine 10 engine opens no window. The Battle.net copy hasn't been tried with the recipe.

knownIssues.symptom: Never opens a window on the default engine, the game process idle (M5, macOS 27.0.1, the Battle.net copy; the Steam copy on an M5 Pro the same, highball#371)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. Blizzard games hit a Rosetta 2 deadlock from January 2026, and CodeWeavers reports Diablo IV and Overwatch running again with macOS 26.5 on CrossOver 26.1 and later
knownIssues.fix: none confirmed. The Wine 11 engines r30 and r31 don't start it either, see the next issue

knownIssues.symptom: On the Wine 11 engines before r35 the Steam copy exits a few seconds after start, before any window (M5 Pro, highball#371). On the Wine 11 engine the Battle.net copy doesn't get that far, Battle.net crashed after login or never drew its window
knownIssues.cause: measured by AlexPako with test builds (highball#371): Wine's fiber copy (engine patches 0008 and 0009) put the game's fiber pointer where macOS keeps the thread's priority class, and D3DMetal calls macOS code from the game's own threads. A Wine without the copy played, the same Wine with it exited after about four seconds. Why macOS stops the process on it (SIGILL) is a reading, not measured
knownIssues.fix: the Wine 11 engine r35 with the game's recipe, in the next Highball release after 0.10.28. It sets HB_FIBER_MIRROR=0 and CX_APPLEGPTK_LIBD3DSHARED_PATH to the engine's libd3dshared.dylib. Without the second the game ran with no window. Battle.net's own crash is a separate problem

knownIssues.symptom: The cursor keeps switching between the game's cursor and the Mac pointer (M5 Pro, highball-db#1194)
knownIssues.cause: seen with the Metal performance HUD on
knownIssues.fix: turn the Metal performance HUD off in the environment's graphics settings and remove MTL_HUD_LOG_ENABLED if it was added, as the reporter did
